review_scope: Root-selected south-center: nominal virtual fallback plane, supplied outdoor spawn and first5m only. Runtime code semantics; no physical garden survey, paving reconstruction or lawful/public access determination.
candidate_reference_status: Provisional file remains unmodified. South-center selection is parent instruction; this runtime review does not change its acceptance status.

semantic_corrections.actual_meaning: At fallback support height .075,3.0 is the default target WORLD altitude relative to the model world-zero datum. The target is2.925 m above that fallback support plane.
semantic_corrections.runtime_formula: groundOffset = groundHeight - DEFAULT_GROUND_HEIGHT; targetWorld = groundOffset + .90 + 2.10 * clamp((effectiveDistance - 3.5) / 10.5, 0, 1)
semantic_corrections.resolution: Parent directed preserving the frozen consumer field while recording this explicit correction. No claim of3m actual clearance above the support plane.

nominal_conditions: Default/reset pitch82 and requested distance14; no user drag/zoom/reset variation after selecting the route.
Settled camera follow anchor, or instant teleport update. Motion smoothing and collision-shortened camera positions are not an exact endpoint replay of this static screen.
No active street sidecar walk-surface changes the support height from .075 along the finite route. Static code review does not assert the loaded browser state.
No runtime building/sidecar obstruction shortens the boom or relocates the spawn. Actual browser checks remain required to observe those behaviors.

coordinate_approximation.runtime_method: offsetPosition uses per-position cos(latitude) for longitude and linear latitude increments.
coordinate_approximation.screen_method: Fixed-anchor WebMercator differences times cos(anchor latitude), then a straight5m ENU segment.
coordinate_approximation.interpretation: The local coordinate approximation differs by about7.6 micrometres in this one nominal5m formula comparison; it is not a simulation of framewise key movement or a mesh/source-ground screen.

collision_scope.online_map: Loaded provider building and water Polygon/MultiPolygon records; no general precise-mesh collision or roof-height waiver.
collision_scope.local_support: Only active SHA-bound flat walk-surface sidecars; otherwise controller fallback .075.
collision_scope.local_obstacles: Only explicit active sidecar obstacle proxies with body/camera flags and vertical intervals.

evidence.finding: Body radius .38 m, body height 1.75 m; fallback support datum .075 world metres; walk/run speeds4.2/8.5 m/s.
Constructor uses pitch82 degrees and cameraDistance14 m; resetCamera restores the same values.
Reset restores pitch82 and distance14.
Only scene groundAt sidecar support overrides fallback .075; no architectural-triangle ground query here.
Local collision requests .38 m body radius,1.75 m height and .2 m maximum step.
Online collision uses destination centre, forward and shoulder probes; local sidecars use a continuous sweep.
Forward movement follows east=sin(bearing), north=cos(bearing); obstruction can cause axis sliding.
Camera groundOffset is actual support height minus .075, not the absolute support height.
Settled14 m distance implies min(3,14*.20)=2.8 m ahead along bearing; moving follow-anchor lag is separate.
Loaded building-footprint/sidecar obstruction can shorten distance by .6 up to three iterations; water alone does not shorten this camera.
For unshortened14 m camera, target world altitude is groundHeight-.075+3, eye is target+14*cos82.
Street support/obstacles require a matching model SHA and an active owner; no unbound precise building mesh automatically creates support.
groundAt returns the highest active flat walk-surface containing the point, or null.
Step checks use fallback .075 when no surface; camera collision is .12 m sweep through explicit obstacle proxies.
Ordinary models load as scene geometry; placement uses altitude/scale/heading and does not derive ground collision from triangles.
Only streetAssembly interaction metadata enters StreetInteraction; visual mesh loading by itself does not register collider triangles.
Online building/building-part and water polygon source features populate a 2D collision cache; underground and nonpolygon records are skipped.
Building polygons block without a vertical roof test; mapped water blocks unless near a mapped bridge.
Tile loading and actual collision may cause findSafePosition to adjust the supplied spawn; code review cannot prove the requested spawn remains unchanged.
Avatar positioning offsets the authored sole datum; MapLibre explicit from/to camera preserves world altitudes by disabling centre-ground clamping.
Scene exposes StreetInteraction support/sweep/camera APIs; no precise-mesh raycast is attached by these APIs.

limitations: This record proves the inspected source behavior and its exact file hashes; it does not execute the application or prove runtime cache contents.
A visually modeled stair, sill, wall, garden surface or opening has no automatic surveyed or traversable ground semantics.
Finite source-ground and raw-model screens remain separate. Dynamic movement, camera shortening, spawn adjustment and return/full/LOD behavior require actual browser evidence.
The virtual plane scope does not require a determination of real-world legal access or a complete courtyard survey; neither is claimed.
